question: Related Questions Q. Moulana i have heard that Our beloved Prophet pbuh had made dua not to give more money to his progeny - so that they dont indulge in this world too much. Is this true? If its true, then does this apply to all the Syed's (i mean till Qayamah)? Please explain in detail. 1298 views Q. Salaam! I believe that niqab is farz. I want to wear it but since I will be the only one doing it in my close surrounding, I do not feel ready to observe niqab during family gatherings. People have been telling me that either you wear niqab all the time or you do not wear it at all. So I would like to know whether it permissible to wear niqab only while going out in the streets or other public places (where there are non muslims strangers) and uncover my face in front of non-mehram relatives (cousins and brothers in law)? I mean is it ok to do it sometimes rather than not doing it at all? 2654 views Q. As salam Walekum, i always see snakes in my dreams. Many times snakes follow me or bite or attack on me. what is meaning of this dream? Also 2 - 3 years ago, when i was sleeping (it was time between Asar & Magarib), & when i woke up, i could smell some perfumes smell(fragance), but when i turned to other side, smell was not there, again on changing side, i could smell fragance (on same place). Why this happened? please help me for the matter as soon as possible. Hoping for your help. Allah hafiz -asma 2789 views Q. islamic beliefs 1665 views Q. Last night in my dream i saw that my grandmother has died .and this is the second time i got this type of dream since last two months can you please help me in this regard .what does this dream indicate?and one more thing i like to inform you that my grandmother is still alive (alhamdulilah). 2071 views Q. Allah's mecry be upon those upon his deen ameen. My question was regarding marytrdom. Why is it that according to Hanafi Fiqh, the shaheed is prayed over. My understanding of Janazah was, the Community are Mashahid over the Mayith, and hence make dua for Allah's mercy etc. As for the Shaheed, then his wounds etc are witness for him etc. And his soul (inshaAllah) would be in the hearts of green birds, roaming Jannah, and you know this narration better than i do. Jazakallahu Khair, I love you for the sake of Allah. 1533 views Q. Assalamu alaikum, i would like to know the meaning of a dream that a friend of mine had. recently her mother passed away, after her mother passed away close friends and relatives told her often that they see her mother in their dreams. after hearing this from her friends she prayed to Allah asking Allah that she wants to see her mother in her dream.That night she had a dream about her mother, in the dream she saw that her mother was buried, but family members and other people had to get her out becuase she was going to have a baby, after her mother was brought out, her mother was taken to the hospital to have her baby, theN she saw that she was running to see her mother, but she was told by doctors that her mother was in the hospital basement, so she ran to the basement but when she got there she saw her mother in a bag the way she was when she first died. My friend would like to know the meaning of this dream. Jazakallah 2191 views Q. Dua to get job 2983 views Q. There is a girl that i wish to marry but i did not know whether i should continue to pursue the marriage or not so i made istikhara and asked Allah to put it in my heart to propose to her, or just leave it. 1378 views
answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 20285 Country: SL Title: please i'm having regular dreams on holding' a baby child,always in avehicle travelling, people giving me money and seeing dirty toilet? Question: salam, please i'm having regular dreams on holding' a baby child,always in avehicle travelling, people giving me money and seeing dirty toilet? Answer ID: 20285 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 478/378/H=1431) Your dream indicates that you are much interested in gaining the world and are unaware of its consequences. The dream is good in a way that it warns you that you should come out of this state and turn towards the hereafter. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
